connect.intro: Your budget lives in a Google Sheet in your own Drive. Nothing is stored on our servers. Google will ask you to let the app create that sheet.

promises.onlyOwnSheet: The app can only see the sheet it creates, nothing else in your Drive.
promises.editAnytime: You can open and edit the sheet yourself at any time.
promises.findsExisting: If you connected before, the app finds your existing sheet instead of making a new one.

errors.NoDriveAccess: Google didn't give the app access to Drive. On Google's screen, tick the box to let Canibuy see, edit and create the Google Drive files it uses, then try again.
errors.SheetFailed: You're connected, but creating your sheet failed. Check that the Google Sheets API and Google Drive API are enabled in the Google Cloud project, then try again.
errors.RefreshFailed: Your Google access expired or was revoked. Connect again to keep using your sheet.
